archPage.title: El Arco de Cabo San Lucas
archPage.subtitle: Land's End on the Baja California peninsula, where the Sea of Cortez meets the Pacific.
archPage.intro: El Arco is the rock formation that closes the southern tip of the Baja California peninsula, at the place the maps call Land's End: the exact point where the Sea of Cortez and the Pacific Ocean meet. It can only be seen from the water, so the only way to stand in front of it is to take a boat out from Cabo San Lucas bay.

beaches.title: Lovers Beach and Divorce Beach
beaches.text: Two beaches separated by the same rock formation: Lovers Beach faces the calm, sheltered Sea of Cortez; Divorce Beach faces the open Pacific, with strong currents and no swimming.

sealions.title: The sea lion colony
sealions.text: A colony of California sea lions lives on the rocks beside the Arch. You can see and hear them from the boat all year round.

whales.title: Whale season
whales.text: Between December and April humpback whales pass through the waters off Los Cabos. Sightings are never guaranteed, but that is when they come close to shore.

archPage.gettingThereText: There is no road: you reach the Arch by boat from Cabo San Lucas bay, and the crossing is short. Check the tours for departure times, duration and what each trip includes, or message us if you would rather put together your own.

firma.title: The dishes that carry her name
firma.subtitle: Scattered right across the menu, from the chilaquiles to the botanero: the ones Rosalinda signs with her own name.

AdminServiceBooking.partyEnableHint: Off, one booking is one person and the price is the price. On, the customer picks how many and each one takes a place.
AdminServiceBooking.partyExceedsCapacity: The biggest single resource holds {seats} people, so a larger party will find no available times.
AdminServiceBooking.noDurationNote: This service has no duration. Bookings will block one hour each - set a duration so the calendar matches how long the work really takes.
AdminServiceBooking.poolsHint: The boats, guides or rooms this service uses. Leave all off to use every one at the location.
AdminServiceBooking.allPoolsNote: None selected - every resource at the location is used.

AdminResourcePools.title: Resources
AdminResourcePools.help: The boats, guides, rooms or tables bookings are placed on here. A booking is put on whichever one still has room for the whole party.
AdminResourcePools.emptyHelp: Optional. With none defined, this location takes {capacity} people at a time, exactly as its capacity above says. Add a pool only when different boats, guides or rooms hold different numbers.
AdminResourcePools.customerSelectable: Let customers pick a specific one
AdminResourcePools.customerSelectableHint: Off, one is assigned automatically and the customer never sees these names. On, they choose from them while booking.
AdminResourcePools.noResources: Nothing here yet - a group with no entries is ignored.
AdminResourcePools.resourceCapacityHint: People. Several identical ones are a single entry with their total - a group never splits across two.

Coupon.appliedAtCheckout: The code will be waiting in your cart at checkout.
